subject: Sponsor shadowing & quiet-brief scheduling — VP/CIO availability
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@solsticesys.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire D'Souza <claire@solsticesys.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor shadowing request + brief window for VP/CIO

Hi Naomi and Ben,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile you showed. We're trying to lock in a short executive briefing next week for our VP of Product (Lara Hayes) and our CIO (Paul Nguyen). They prefer a very small "quiet" pre-brief (15 min) with the sponsor, then a 30–40 minute demo where they'll listen in and ask high-level questions.

Quick asks:
- Can Redwood provide a sponsor who can shadow the session and be the primary technical point during the demo?
- Do you have a short pre-brief slot available (15 minutes) on Mon/Tue morning PST?

I'm attaching the internal agenda we use so you can see the cadence (solstice-agenda.pdf). If useful, Claire is on this thread and can share attendee constraints.

Best,
Evan

--
Evan Brooks
Head of Partnerships | Solstice Systems
evansignature@solsticesys.com
Attachment: solstice-agenda.pdf (agenda, 1 page)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@solsticesys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor shadowing request + brief window for VP/CIO

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear note. Happy to coordinate.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can provide a sponsor engineer to shadow (I'll propose Marissa as primary and Ben as backup).
- We can do a 15-min pre-brief + 40-min demo.

Proposed pre-brief/demo windows (PST):
- Mon 2026-08-31: 08:30–09:30 (pre-brief 08:30–08:45, demo 08:45–09:25)
- Tue 2026-09-01: 09:00–10:00 (pre-brief 09:00–09:15, demo 09:15–09:55)

Notes and asks:
- Please confirm whether Lara or Paul will want the session recorded. Our execs sometimes prefer not to be recorded; if recording is off we will mark that in the calendar.
- I'll attach a short runbook (two-page) with sponsor talking points and the handoff script.

I'll wait for which day/time works and whether recording is allowed. If those windows don't fit, tell me two alternatives and we'll try to slot.

Thanks — Naomie

--
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
a.naomi@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-exec-briefing-notes.docx (2 pages)

Naomi,

Appreciate the windows. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Monday 2026-08-31 at 08:30 PST works best for Lara and Paul.
- Lara prefers the session not be recorded. Paul is fine either way but will follow Lara's lead.
- Claire suggests a short 10-min sync for the sponsor immediately after the pre-brief to align Q&A roles (if Marissa can stay 5–10 minutes after the pre-brief that'd be ideal).

Claire also forwarded a small list of business priorities for Lara (I'll paste below) so you can highlight the sections in the demo:
- Reduce inference tail latency for small LLM calls (customer-facing search)
- Lower per-token cost for their embedding pipeline
- Auditability of inference logs for SOC-style requests

Let us know if you want a short run-through before Monday; otherwise we'll plan for the pre-brief at 08:30 (no recording).

Thanks — Evan

- 0:00–0:03: Intros and scope (who's on the call & ask)

- 0:08–0:12: Confirm recording off and agreed follow-ups
- 0:12–0:15: Align who answers which exec questions

If anyone wants a dry-run earlier in the day, I'm available 12:00–12:30 PST Monday.
